text: なんだよー　おまえなんか　あっちいけよー！

patterns.name: 〜なんか
patterns.explanation: なんか after a person or thing talks it down, like 'the likes of'. おまえなんか = 'the likes of you'.

patterns.name: 〜しろ (command)
patterns.explanation: Changing いく to いけ makes a blunt order, and the stretched よ pushes it harder. いけよー = 'just go!'.
